name: fovea
description: Filters large Bash outputs to the blocks relevant to the agent's task, verbatim, with an outline of what was skipped. A fast decision model (TypeSafe Jev via OpenRouter) scores each block; the rest stays one cat away.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Key for the default judge (TypeSafe Jev via OpenRouter). Leave empty if OPENROUTER_API_KEY is already set in your environment. Without a key Fovea does nothing.
